description: Owns reusable native iOS engineering practice, delivery, and independent evaluation.

repository_signals: An actual Xcode project, workspace or package identifies an affected native iOS app target, with iOS SDK/deployment settings and an iPhone or iPad destination. [IOS-IDENTITY] [IOS-DEVICE]

The requested work affects SwiftUI, UIKit or their interoperability within that identified native iOS target; a .swift file or a multiplatform framework name alone does not establish iOS identity. [IOS-UI] [IOS-UIKIT]

These signals describe applicability; Kernel 4.0 currently matches the exact task_type and does not enforce signals. The ios-prepare Skill verifies actual native admission before dependent execution; macOS-only, server Swift, watchOS-only and unverified-platform scope are not admitted.

compatibility.statement: Compatible with Kernel protocol 4.0: Kernel owns activation, matching, stage scheduling and task state; this Domain owns professional prepare, execute, independent evaluate and summarize through the existing lifecycle.json stage Skill bindings, professional rules and capabilities. No routine task-plan presentation or digest approval checkpoint applies. Task scope, user instructions and platform authorization remain binding; signing, distribution and other dependent actions require verified access and applicable task authorization. Ordinary failures are recorded and feasible independent work continues; report passed, failed, blocked and skipped coverage distinctly without converting unavailable evidence into success. Evidence in evidence/lifecycle-v4.json is historical candidate-routing and independent artifact-assessment provenance, not live activation, final Pack approval, product acceptance, physical-device verification, Runtime success or release acceptance.
